entry.title: Market brief — 27 Nov 2026 close
entry.summary: Indian market brief in plain English: Friday 27 November 2026 was the last trading session, with the Nifty 50 closing at 25,607.20 (-277.30, -1.07%) and the Sensex at 83,339.26 (-989.33, -1.17%), and the rupee at 92.98 per dollar. IBJA's 12:00 IST benchmark put 24K gold at ₹1,25,316 per 10 g (+2,334) and 999 silver at ₹1,53,275 per kg (+6,342). The exchanges are shut on Saturday 28 and Sunday 29 November 2026, so these are Friday's levels, re-checked against two independent sources on Saturday 28 November 2026; the next session is Monday 30 November 2026. Education, not advice.
